messages:
marta: quick sync - doing a transport dry-run for private-installer v1.4.6 -> customer VPCs tonight 22:00 UTC. main goals: verify cosign pipeline, exercise escort prefetch, and validate deploy-bot backoff.
liam: which escorts are we using for the dry-run?
marta: picked a small cross-region set: escort-usw-1, escort-usw-2, escort-euw-1, escort-euw-2, escort-ap-sg1 (if healthy). need 3 healthy per-region quorum to consider pass.
tasha: sounds good. i'll run cosign verify + mirror sha checks preflight. sharing commands in case folks need to reproduce: 
```
$ cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/installer-sign installer-v1.4.6.tar.gz
Verification OK: installer-v1.4.6.tar.gz
$ sha256sum installer-v1.4.6.tar.gz
3b2f...  installer-v1.4.6.tar.gz
```
ben: rollback rules proposal: immediate abort + repin previous manifest if any cosign verification failure OR >3% delivery failures across canaries OR any escort reports unrecoverable KMS error. Also auto-step-down throttle to 10% if average handshake >600s.
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder - prefetch signer tokens enabled. Cache priming scheduled 21:50 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run job 5409991234 for installer-v1.4.6 -> canary-escorts. throttle=50%, window=30m. will post progress every 5m.
liam: recommend prefetching signature blobs into the offline signer cache to avoid KMS spikes at pin time. Ops please confirm cache priming.
ben: ops confirmed. priming will include rehydrating cosign sigs into local cache and a health-check against each escort.
tasha: running tail on transport.log now. seeing a transient 90s timeout on escort-usw-2 earlier but retry succeeded. cosign verifications are green.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dry-run start -> canary set [escort-usw-1, escort-usw-2, escort-euw-1, escort-euw-2, escort-ap-sg1]. progress update scheduled.
marta: decision points: if no cosign/KMS issues and <1% delivery errors -> proceed to staged pin (epoch-staged-2026-04-12) at 23:30 UTC. If between 1%-3% errors -> pause and triage for 15m. >3% -> abort + repin. Also manual abort allowed anytime.
liam: add automatic concurrency backoff on observed egress errors to avoid retry storms. deploy-bot can reduce concurrency incrementally.
ben: drafting release blurb: "Private installer v1.4.6 - dry-run initiated; staged pin scheduled for 23:30 UTC pending signoff. No cosign key rotation in this release. Watch window until 00:30 UTC."
ops-bot: ops-bot: cache priming completed at 21:52 UTC. signer latency samples: median 85ms, p95 420ms. will monitor for spikes.
tasha: 22:06 UTC update - all cosign checks OK; no verification mismatches. small retry noise from escort-ap-sg1 (packet loss).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dry-run progress: 4/5 escorts completed successfully, 1/5 had transient retries. artifact pinned to epoch-dryrun-2026-04-12.
marta: ok, hold for 23:15 signoff. @tasha please confirm no KMS anomalies by then. if clear, we'll start staged-pin at 23:30 with throttle=25% and canary escalation plan.
tasha: will post final signoff at 23:15. I'll also push transport.log tail for the last 30m if anything looks suspect.
liam: small ops note - during staged pin let's keep a short-lived metric that tracks cosign verify latency by escort; if any escort crosses 2s consistently, abort.
ben: agreed. adding that to the rollout guardrails.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled staged-pin job (if signoff) with throttle=25%, epoch=staged-2026-04-12, escalate rules applied. will post completion + metrics.
marta: thanks everyone. i'll escalate to on-call immediately if anything odd. planning retrospective notes after window. :thumbsup:
